label: lem:topological-mass-cat-eigenspace
title: Eigenspace decomposition of the categorical mass integrand
html:
Let \alpha = (\int_A \otimes \mathrm{id}) \circ \Delta \circ \varrho form the categorical mass integrand of a closed cycle \varrho. When the Frobenius pairing is compatible with the *-involution, the descent involution \hat{\tau}_n produces an orthogonal decomposition of \alpha into descended and transient components, giving

  \mathfrak{m}(\varrho)^2
  =
  \bigl\lVert \mathrm{tr}(\hat{\tau}_n(\alpha)) \bigr\rVert^2
  +
  \bigl\lVert \mathrm{tr}(\alpha - \hat{\tau}_n(\alpha)) \bigr\rVert^2.

(Orthogonal components add in quadrature, not linearly. The descended and transient traces are orthogonal, so the masses combine by the Pythagorean law, not additively.)
heading: Lemma
